projects.title: AutoFix AI
projects.summary: Moving from a vulnerability report to a proposed code change with tool orchestration, code retrieval and response validation.
projects.problem: A remediation workflow needs to connect structured vulnerability details with relevant code before it can propose a change.
projects.contribution: I built the agent workflow, including report parsing, tool orchestration, structured JSON contracts, and error-recovery loops.
projects.status: Built during the Sec4Sys freelance engagement, which ended in June 2026. Implementation private; current maintenance status is not established.

engineeringNotes.title: Source evidence stays authoritative
engineeringNotes.detail: Preserve immutable source identity and revisions. Search representations and bounded views reference the original evidence instead of replacing it.

engineeringNotes.title: Context budgets are a contract
engineeringNotes.detail: Retain the original table while offering source-backed views that fit the context reader. A relevant search hit must also be expandable into usable evidence.

engineeringNotes.title: Uncertainty is explicit
engineeringNotes.detail: Separate unsupported or uncertain interpretations from accepted, source-grounded results.

projects.validation: Seven of seven scoped structural integration checks passed against disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO. The full real-provider gate failed on outage-versus-GPU-resource error classification; a positive structural slice is not full provider or source-to-answer acceptance.
constraints: The receipt investigation diagnosed fragmentation; the original receipt has not yet been shown to pass through the current structural implementation.
A 37-member invoice table covered 22 source spans, exceeding the context reader’s 16-span budget. Bounded two-span label/value views preserved references to the original table.
Shared Knowledge Pool and provenance relationships do not establish a delivered Knowledge Graph retrieval system.

about.introduction: From robotics and computer vision to applied GenAI, my work connects models to the software and systems around them.
paragraphs: My projects span conveyor monitoring with computer vision, customer analytics, and connected robotics. That work involved processing data, integrating hardware and making the result usable in an application.

At Techgenius, I developed API-driven workflows with FastAPI, LLM APIs and MQTT-connected sensors. My overlapping freelance work at Sec4Sys extended that practice into a LangGraph vulnerability-remediation workflow.
Today, my focus is applied GenAI: connecting models to tools and source evidence, defining processing contracts, and investigating failures across extraction, retrieval and application boundaries.

engineeringApproach.title: Follow the failure across boundaries.
engineeringApproach.description: An unexpected answer may begin in extraction or retrieval. In CIE, I traced single-character fragments from PDFium observations through canonical content to the legacy search index.

engineeringApproach.title: Build the workflow around the model.
engineeringApproach.description: A patch proposal needs more than a model call. AutoFix connects report parsing and code retrieval with response validation, tool execution and recovery loops.
